name: Ann De Schutter
story: DOC profiled Ann De Schutter in 2015 as a Christchurch Geospatial Analyst supporting mapping, spatial analysis, 1080 projects, application training and GPS/GIS support. She later presented imagery and drone work on Auckland Island at the 2019 New Zealand Esri User Conference.
